title: Funerals and Jack Lane's band
summary: Funeral bands, which he associates with Black bands, and Jack Lane, whom he never played with.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Jazz funerals: dirges, hot return, second line

blocks.x: I wondered, Papa Lane once told me that he played to his brass band, played for funerals too. Did your brass band ever play for any funerals? No, another day. I know niggas used to have brass bands that they're

for them a regular you know. Yeah. At the nigger band. They'd be going down there when they come back it's chippy get a head cut you know. All that kind of stuff you know. Yeah stuff. But the niggas don't,
I don't think they're using them old bands to bury the dead. No, I don't think either. You don't hear much of it.

Oh yeah. Sometimes, not very often, sometimes. Yeah, uh-huh. But Papa Lane told me that his band used to play for those funerals the white funerals the same way. Jack Lane used to play. Jack Lane. Did you ever play with Jack Lane?

No, I never did. Did you hear his thing? He used to have a lot of scrubs you understand, play with him. I never did see where he had a real band you understand that you could say was everybody played they pause. But he, a noisy fella you see. He used to get the bag, get jobs. He oft times asked me to play but I told him I'm engaged.
